function.name: todo_add
function.description: Creates a new todo entry in the list with the provided content. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

priority.description: The priority level of the todo item.

due_date.description: The due date for the todo item in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'.

completed.description: Flag indicating whether the todo item is completed.

function.name: todo_delete
function.description: Deletes a to-do item from the list based on the specified content. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The specific content of the to-do item to be identified and removed from the list.

function.name: todo_update
function.description: Update a specific to-do item identified by its old content with new content in the to-do list. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

old_content.description: The original content of the to-do item that needs to be updated. This is used to find and identify the specific item in the to-do list.

new_content.description: The new content that will replace the old content of the identified to-do item.
